title: K0 manual water sampling caddy
summary: Record repeatable manual water observations before purchasing permanent sensors.
limitations: A sample caddy cannot certify swimming safety or water treatment.
Laboratory analysis must use its own method-approved bottles and handling rules.
All parts and EUR ranges are planning estimates, not supplier offers.
No precise residential address or sensor coordinate is published.

parts.description: One-litre sealed HDPE screening bottles; not lab-certified containers
parts.substitution_test: Confirm target method accepts vessel and that caps do not leak.

parts.description: Handheld thermometer with stated calibration or cross-check method
parts.substitution_test: Compare duplicate readings and retain calibration provenance.

parts.description: Clean, removable carrying tray for sealed sample vessels
parts.substitution_test: Verify both sealed bottles fit and tray can be cleaned.

parts.description: Water-resistant labels, waterproof pen and dated paper log
parts.substitution_test: Verify label remains readable after wet handling and links to the log.

parts.description: Disposable gloves and replacement containment supplies
parts.substitution_test: Verify clean handling and record single-use material disposal.

acceptance.method: Check UTC, depth, weather, sampler, instrument, reference and missing-data flags.
Fill with clean water, invert in the tray and inspect cap and labels before use.
